messages:
Iris (Design): Quick thread: noticed a weird visual and accessibility combo on the console table. when a cell overflows we show an ellipsis and tooltip on hover, but VoiceOver reads both the truncated text and the tooltip which duplicates info. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/ellipsis-voiceover.png
Marco (Frontend): Huh. I thought the tooltip was aria-hidden. looks like we accidentally set role=tooltip AND left it in the DOM for screen readers. CSS: .cell-tooltip{display:block;position:absolute} — might be the culprit.
Jen (PM): Users want dense tables but also reliable screen reader output. Can we keep compact spacing but ensure only the cell content is read?
Rohan (Dev): Two options: move tooltip content to aria-label on hover target, or set tooltip role to presentation and expose aria-describedby linking to a hidden element. prefer aria-describedby so NVDA/VoiceOver get consistent behaviour.
Iris (Design): I lean to aria-describedby referencing an offscreen element so sighted users get the tooltip on hover and screen reader users get the full text deterministically. keep visible ellipsis, don't change copy.
a11y-bot: Best practice: avoid duplicating tooltip text in accessibility tree. Use aria-describedby for contextual content and ensure only one accessible name exposed. Also ensure tooltip is not focusable.
Marco (Frontend): Proposed patch:
```
/* make tooltip decorative for AT, expose via offscreen helper */
.tooltip { role: presentation; }
.cell[aria-describedby] .sr-only { position:absolute; left:-9999px }
cell.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=> { helper.textContent = fullText; cell.setAttribute('aria-describedby','helper-'+id) })
```
I'll add unit tests and a small e2e with VoiceOver assertions.
Jen (PM): How does this touch spacing tokens? compact rows are at spacing.xs (8) and comfortable at spacing.s (12). we should avoid changing token names this sprint.
Iris (Design): Agreed, no token renames. For compact mode I'll propose a micro-adjust: reduce side padding but keep vertical at 10px. update token docs with a "compact alias" mapping.
Rohan (Dev): Also flagged: toast stacking on the dashboard overlaps the new sticky table header when multiple toasts pop. Fix by using toast.offsetTop token and increasing by 6-10px in compact theme. less risky than changing header z-index.
Marco (Frontend): Will include toast.offsetTop bump in theme override and add visual regression snapshots.
a11y-bot: Checklist for PR: no duplicate accessible names, tooltip not focusable, aria-describedby present, screenreader-only helper exists, hit targets >=44x44 if we change interactive surface, tooltips timeouts < 10s for keyboard users, live region updates are polite.
Iris (Design): Copy note: keep tooltip copy identical to full content; visible cell stays truncated. Tooltip label should be plain sentence, no button-like language.
Jen (PM): Target patch 3.2.2 for this fix. Non-breaking, doc updates only for tokens (compact alias).
Rohan (Dev): I'll open PR with code, tests, Percy diffs. Can someone pair on VoiceOver test after CI?
Iris (Design): I can pair. scheduling 20 min after CI passes. also I'll update design token docs with the compact alias mapping and a short rationale. :memo:
